Name: Cuter Coops and Better Barns
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
i got sick of the traffic jams inside my coops, so i made them slightly bigger — and then decorated them (and the barns) while i was at it

wall colour options originally from nykachu's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3874]coop and barn facelift[/url]. download that instead if you prefer less clutter
